description: This source file implements the 'phy_to_fapi_results_event_fastpath_translator' class, which translates PHY layer results into FAPI indications for various radio events such as PRACH, PUSCH, PUCCH, SRS, and RACH. It includes methods for handling different result types, converting signal metrics, and building corresponding FAPI indication messages.

classes.name: p7_indications_notifier_dummy
classes.description: A dummy implementation of the fapi::p7_indications_notifier interface, with empty override methods for indication callbacks.

methods.name: phy_to_fapi_results_event_fastpath_translator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the translator with sector ID, calibration value, and logger.

methods.name: on_new_prach_results
methods.description: Handles new PRACH results, generating RACH indication messages if preambles are valid.

methods.name: on_new_pusch_results_control
methods.description: Processes PUSCH control results, triggering UCI indication notifications.

methods.name: on_new_pusch_results_data
methods.description: Processes PUSCH data results, triggering CRC and RX data indication notifications.

methods.name: notify_pusch_uci_indication
methods.description: Builds and sends UCI indication for PUSCH results.

methods.name: notify_crc_indication
methods.description: Builds and sends CRC indication message for PUSCH results.

methods.name: notify_rx_data_indication
methods.description: Builds and sends RX data indication message for PUSCH results.

methods.name: on_new_pucch_results
methods.description: Handles new PUCCH results, creating appropriate indication messages based on format.

methods.name: on_new_srs_results
methods.description: Processes SRS results, generating SRS indication messages.
